title: Draft strip test clicks before the control appears
description:
Observed: Full browser runs failed because the unsent draft button was absent immediately after switching views.

Expected: The test waits until the draft control is present before clicking it.

Reproduction: Run the full UI suite under slower timing; feature draft survives polls can fail at the draft button click.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Wait for the draft control before clicking; preserve the draft assertion.

notes: The sync-error UI test left an unsent draft open, triggering an unload confirmation that interfered with later tests. Discarding it before closing restored the sequence; bun test passed 243, failed 0.
